headline: E. Stroudsburg win at Millersville and now host Gannon
dek: E. Stroudsburg have won away at Lock Haven and then at Millersville without conceding in either, and on Sunday the leaders come to them. Gannon arrive having beaten Seton Hill, with thirteen wins, three draws and three defeats across the season.
displaced_by: Gannon's win over Seton Hill took them to thirteen wins, so the standing dek was no longer true; E. Stroudsburg's away win at Millersville sets up their home match with the leaders.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.) and Shippensburg together and conceded 24, so the tallest bar stands on attack: theirs is a lead in goals scored, not in goals kept out.

wire.line: Millersville have met E. Stroudsburg at home and away this season and have yet to score against them.
